findings.issue: No correction needed: the electrode-specific mass-change possibilities are correct standard-chemistry additions.
findings.evidence: Oxidation can consume a solid anode, causing mass loss; reduction can deposit material at a cathode, causing mass gain. Gas evolution can occur at either electrode, depending on the half-reaction. The draft appropriately says 'can occur' rather than presenting these observations as universal.
